chunks: Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sukuni, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام: concerning
a slave who inflicted a clarifying head wound upon a man, then another inflicted a wound; he said: “It is divided between the two of them.”

key_terms.آخَرَ: another person who also inflicted a wound
key_terms.بَيْنَهُمَا: shared between the two of them
key_terms.عَبْدٍ: a slave; the person described as one of those involved in causing the injury
key_terms.مُوضِحَةً: a wound that exposes the bone

ai.seo_question: How is liability divided when two people inflict sequential head wounds in Shia hadith law?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding liability in cases of head wounds involving more than one assailant. It indicates that responsibility for the injury is shared between the two parties mentioned.
